Our project file describes it as near completion and carries a third-party 2026 completion note, but this entry is not officially confirmed. Official HDB roadshow resources, checked in our file on 7 November 2026, do not confirm a project-wide TOP or key date, and key appointments are unconfirmed. Unit counts and any completion year are therefore left out of the facts below. If you have an HDB key letter, use that. The word “Beacon” is not treated as a confirmed outlook. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Yishun Beacon renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Yishun Beacon interior
sections.text:
Yishun Central is the town-centre belt of a mature northern town. Owners who are close to keys usually want a first fit-out that works immediately: a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry shoe cabinet, and a living-room storage wall, rather than a temporary arrangement of loose furniture. Maison designs that work as built-in carpentry, not as IKEA-style furniture, and we will draw only from your approved plan. No official floor plan is on file, so typologies are not listed, and we will not invent a typical Yishun Beacon layout.

Chencharu Acres is the other Yishun page in this batch; it is a November 2026 BTO launch and is years away from keys. Chong Pang City, also in Yishun in this batch, is a retail and community development, not a typologies reference for this HDB estate. We will not invent walking times to Yishun town or to any MRT station. Check your block, facing and the HDB renovation rules before you plan blinds, a bench or any hacking.

After keys, inspect defects and obtain the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals, as an editorial figure only. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.
